card.thesis: Round 44 trim cell. Basket (power): Creator A's and Creator D's electricity-infrastructure-as-AI-bottleneck thesis: two regulated utilities (NEE, DUK), one merchant/renewable utility (SO), one uranium miner (CCJ) -- a proxy for 'the grid and its fuel', not a literal transcription of either persona's named tickers, neither of whom stated one. Universe: NEE DUK SO CCJ. Purpose ROTH: no ticker this round trades is claimed by any savings- or trading-purpose card in the live library (app.evolution.promotion._library_cards, all six tiers), because Rev. Rul. 2008-5 destroys rather than defers a wash-sale loss whose replacement is bought inside an IRA. Five of these twenty names (AMAT, KLAC, LRCX, XOP, XME) ARE already held by other roth-purpose cards elsewhere in the library -- legal and disclosed: find_disjointness_violations only ever compares a roth card against the TAXABLE universe, and roth-to-roth overlap creates no wash-sale exposure under Rev. Rul. 2008-5, since nothing is ever repurchased inside the taxable book. Ticker disjointness from the taxable book is NECESSARY, not sufficient, under IRC section 1091; nothing here is a section 1091-safety claim. The Roth benchmark is SPY, price-only, no dividends -- none of these five baskets is a US large-cap-growth book, so a raw adjusted_excess-vs-SPY reading is not this round's decision quantity for any basket; the decision quantities are basket-minus-control (does the theme beat a broad passive control, held passively) and trim-minus-passive (does stepping a name to cash above its own 200-day*1.15 extension beat holding it). Every note in the persona corpus that produced this hypothesis has published=null (PERSONA-HYPOTHESES.md), so the bull-2024 and recent windows are IN-SAMPLE to the hypothesis and any positive result confined to them is hindsight, not a finding -- the fair test is the six windows ending by 2022-10 (gfc, chop-2011, chop-2015, q4-2018, covid, bear-2022), reported separately. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any card ran. Not investment advice; no influencer is endorsed. See strategy-program/ROUND-44-PLAN.md.
card.falsification: Pre-registered decision rule (PROTOCOL.md section 7 floor, 21.2pp): a basket edge requires median(r44-power-passive) minus median(r44-control-passive) > 21.2pp AND BH q<0.10 over all 10 cells this round runs; a trim edge requires median(r44-power-trim) minus median(r44-power-passive) > 21.2pp AND the same BH q<0.10. A margin inside the floor is a null whichever side it lands on, and the pre-registered prediction is null on both axes (39 prior rounds found every basket- and rule-margin this programme has ever measured inside this floor). This is the rule-question card, matched to r44-power-passive by universe, slots, size and absent brackets -- the two differ in exactly one thing (PROTOCOL.md section 7). Predicted to UNDERPERFORM its own passive control in bull-2024 and recent (sustained uptrends give the trim's stop-out nothing to avoid and only cost re-entry lag), and to have its best chance of beating it in bear-2022 and gfc, where a run-up-then-reversal sequence is most plausible. Exposure prediction: trim sits out most in this basket if it is semicap (mean support ~34%, ROUND-44-PLAN.md section 3a) and least if it is power (~11%, driven by SO's 3.8% and DUK's 4.6%). Nothing is promoted from this round regardless of outcome.
